answer: Each agent identity requires a bond locked in escrow and one hardware credential, registered at dawn of each epoch. Forging 1,000 identities locks 2,000,000 units, with 50% slashed on proven fraud and a 30-epoch wait before withdrawal. Splitting identities raises marginal cost per fake and triggers a shared penalty, since independent jurors cross-check credentials and detect duplicates before the claim reaches its zenith; every disputed bond returns an echo of the same slashing.
